text: The purpose of this report is to appoint directors to the Boards of Management of three (3) Business Improvement Areas that fall within the Toronto and East York Community Council boundaries for the new term of Council and make necessary changes to Schedule A of the Municipal Code, Chapter 19.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. In accordance with the City's Public Appointments Policy, appointed the following nominees to the Business Improvement Area Boards of Management set out below at the pleasure of Toronto and East York Community Council, and for a term expiring at the end of the term of Council or as soon thereafter as successors are appointed: Bloordale Village: Couto, Oliver Duff-Bergeron, Alycia Lukashevsky, Liza Lumsden, Alicia Harrison, Mazis Parr, Matthew Perry, Robert Scioscia, Carmine Tsourounakis, Niki Danforth Village: Chun, David Dapergolas, Louis Hossain, Akram Khan, Farhana Lu, Ding (David) McLachlon, Nathan Rahman, Khokan Rahman, Mizanur Rahman, Rasal Taylor, Trevor Leslieville: Daniels, Brad Kelly, Tracy Mamourian, Ara Montiel, Rebecca Orenstein, Jennifer Peckover, Donald Tetreault, Christiane 2.
